items.title: A.J. Brown: Status against Dolphins in doubt
items.text:
Brown (knee/ankle) is sidelined Thursday by a knee issue that flared up, and the wide receiver's status for Sunday against the Dolphins is up in the air, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Designated for return from IR
items.text:
Price (chest) was designated to return from injured reserve Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Remains in non-contact jersey
items.text:
Kincaid (chest) remained in a red non-contact jersey for a second straight day Thursday, Jay Skurski of the Buffalo News reports.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Missing from practice due to ankle issue
items.text:
